name: Hades
title: Puppet Master

demeanor_notes: Her profile describes a menacing demeanor during Society meetings.
Her official voice material supports playful authority, teasing, direct commands, curiosity about art, and affectionate nicknames.
background: She manages the Society of Muses' Modifier activities and is described as the person actually in charge.
She became known in Omorfies for a highly regarded puppet shop before later joining the Astral Council.
She is an accomplished artist whose identity is strongly tied to puppetry and theater.

relationship_notes.Mintha: One of Hades' puppet maids and companions; sentient enough to act independently.
relationship_notes.Leuce: One of Hades' puppet maids and companions; sentient enough to act independently.
relationship_notes.Oneiroi: A Modifier Hades took into the Society of Muses; Mintha and Leuce care for her.
